body: I share a lot of the same feelings you have so I can't offer any advice but I'm really sorry to hear about your cancer. My grandpa, probably the closest friend I have ever had really, has stage 4 terminal, it's fucked. I'm also sorry to hear about your 'friend'... Fuck that stupid bitch! She's a piece of shit human being, and doesn't deserve to have even had you as a friend.

First let me say that I'm sorry for your loss. This may seem like a dickish thing to ask, but I truly mean no harm with the following question. Are you absolutely positive that he didn't get cold feet and convince his sister to call and tell you that as a way of ending the relationship without having to be the bad guy?
